case.given: 系统创建一个新的 track 或 mission 规划目录。
case.then: 系统 SHALL create `design.md` and `decisions.xnl` unconditionally。
case.and: 系统 SHALL create `decisions/` and `memory/` only when they have eligible content。

case.given: 一个 mission requires concrete control work for one or more project contexts。
case.when: its mission.xml is authored or validated。
case.then: 系统 SHALL persist one complete default ActorSet with exactly MissionPlanner, MissionObserver, MissionReconciler, and MissionApplier。
case.and: 每个 TaskGroup SHALL inherit that set or reference a complete local override。
系统 SHALL persist only path-free unique ProjectRef identities and reject unknown or duplicate references。

case.given: 一个 mission references an external ProjectRef or TrackLink。
case.when: impl-mission observes and reconciles actual state。
case.then: 系统 SHALL resolve workspace paths only through session-local WorkspaceBinding and SHALL NOT persist those paths。
case.and: 缺少 binding SHALL project UNBOUND rather than candidate, missing, or persistent Mission state。
binding exists but an external track is absent SHALL project MISSING from the target project actual state。
无关 DAG branches SHALL remain eligible when they do not depend on an UNBOUND ProjectRef。

case.given: 用户创建或执行一个 mission with ActorSets and external ProjectRefs。
case.when: plan-mission, impl-mission, and the Mission XML spec describe the workflow。
case.then: 系统 SHALL describe session WorkspaceBinding, external TrackLink observation, UNBOUND recovery, and complete ActorSet override semantics。
case.and: 系统 SHALL provide one single-project feedback loop and one bottom-library/top-application two-project feedback loop example without absolute paths。
